name: 双尾飞行结算
description: 在免疫与不可操作持续时间结束时，同步结算预留搬运。
skillCode: var tails=context.rulePiece;if(!tails||context.playerId!==tails.ownerPlayerId)return {success:false,message:''};var tag=(tails.statusTags||[]).find(function(t){return t.type==='tails-flight-reservation'&&t.ownerId===tails.instanceId;});if(!tag){removeRuleById(tails.instanceId,'rule-tails-flight-resolve');return {success:false,message:''};}if(tag.appliedTurn===battle.turn.turnNumber||tag.currentDuration>1)return {success:true,message:'双尾飞行等待后续己方回合结束'};var ally=battle.pieces.find(function(p){return p.instanceId===tag.allyId&&p.currentHp>0;});var cells=[{x:tag.x,y:tag.y},{x:tag.allyX,y:tag.allyY}];var occupied=function(cell){return battle.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.instanceId!==tails.instanceId&&p.instanceId!==(ally&&ally.instanceId)&&p.x===cell.x&&p.y===cell.y;});};var legal=cells.every(function(cell){var tile=battle.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===cell.x&&t.y===cell.y;});return tile&&tile.props&&tile.props.walkable&&!occupied(cell);});if(ally&&legal){tails.x=tag.x;tails.y=tag.y;ally.x=tag.allyX;ally.y=tag.allyY;}[tails,ally].filter(Boolean).forEach(function(p){(p.statusTags||[]).filter(function(t){return t.flightId===tag.flightId;}).forEach(function(t){removeStatusEffectById(p.instanceId,t.id);});});if(battle.extensions&&battle.extensions.tileEffects)battle.extensions.tileEffects=battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(e){return e.flightId!==tag.flightId;});removeRuleById(tails.instanceId,'rule-tails-flight-resolve');return {success:true,message:legal&&ally?'双尾飞行完成搬运':'双尾飞行落点失效，搬运取消'};
